units.name: field-verification-openapi-foundation
units.objective: Re-pin A, repair any contract/OpenAPI prerequisite blocker, prove package/runtime test gates, and forbid stale DONE inheritance.

units.name: identity-workforce-session-readiness
units.objective: Replace competing Field provisioning paths with one Workforce-orchestrated Identity+profile command, independent-provider contracts, one activation-readiness policy and complete canonical Control Panel provider profile/activation flow.

units.name: field-work-center-home-tasks-navigation
units.objective: Keep the four-tab app-field navigation, converge Home/Tasks/deep-links on canonical work objects, and remove duplicate/dead navigation truth.

units.name: field-onboarding-assignment
units.objective: Close one-active-assignment lifecycle with formal handoff, priority/dueAt/SLA/overdue, optional location at assignment but required event location before governed visit/onboarding completion, and Work Queue truth.

units.name: partner-store-onboarding-lifecycle
units.objective: Allow both self-initiated and assignment-linked Field onboarding, preserve provenance, legal Partner→Stores model, canonical Business Vertical and one draft/review lifecycle without publication bypass.

units.name: documents-media-review-taxonomy
units.objective: Close typed legal documents and evidence states: uploaded/reviewed/rejected/expired with reviewer/audit, camera-first field evidence and legal file/gallery support.

units.name: onboarding-collaboration-visibility
units.objective: Organize every field-causal Partners tab into one coherent workspace with object-scoped collaboration/change requests/read visibility and no generic duplicate chat or silent draft editing.

units.name: visits-checklists-readiness-escalations
units.objective: Implement event-based GPS evidence without continuous tracking, Business-Vertical checklist policy managed by Control Panel, independent Partners readiness approval and governed escalation lifecycle.

units.name: catalog-publication-cross-surface-readback
units.objective: Preserve Central Catalog master truth, Field assortment/proposals, and make Marketing the publication owner with server composite gate, audited override and same-ID positive/negative Partner/Client readback.

units.name: offline-unknown-result-reconciliation
units.objective: Extend governed offline support to onboarding drafts/evidence, keep Catalog cache+draft+revalidation, 30-day retention and visible pending/failed/quarantined reconciliation without blind retry.

units.name: field-finance-payout-governance
units.objective: Close WLT-owned policy-driven Field commissions, masked Finance-owned payout destination, governed payout and offboarding settlement while removing Field COD, incidents and penalties.

units.name: field-security-isolation-audit
units.objective: Apply proportional server-side object isolation/audit for a small operator team without unnecessary role proliferation, and delete UI-only or stale authorization paths.

units.name: native-capability-deprecation-register
units.objective: Evidence-classify every app-field native dependency/capability before removal.

units.name: consolidated-native-cleanup-build-window
units.objective: Remove only confirmed obsolete native dependencies/config/permissions in one coherent build window and prove an EAS Preview artifact.

units.name: field-final-red-team-e2e-closure
units.objective: Close only on one exact latest A SHA after final cleanup, Android real-device E2E, Control Panel/Partners/Marketing/WLT verification, same-ID Partner/Client readback, security and applicable CI with zero known in-scope defect.
